title: C# Syntax
description: C# is an object-oriented programming language developed by Microsoft.

challenges.title: Basic Statement
challenges.exercise: Every C# statement ends with a semicolon. Print 'Semi' with a semicolon at the end.

challenges.title: Comments
challenges.exercise: Use a single-line comment '//' and print 'Ok'.

challenges.title: Case Sensitivity
challenges.exercise: C# is case sensitive. Print 'text'. Note: Console.WriteLine is different from console.writeline.

challenges.title: Main Method
challenges.exercise: Print the name of the method where execution starts: 'Main'.

challenges.title: Namespace Logic
challenges.exercise: Print 'System' which is a common namespace used in C#.
